# Dan Stilling DFF

> > Professional cinematography portfolio of Dan Stilling, DFF, showcasing commercial work and narrative cinematography for major brands and productions.

Dan Stilling is a Director of Photography (DFF) specializing in commercial cinematography and narrative filmmaking. His portfolio features work with major brands including Hilton, Disney, Dior, and Chick-Fil-A, as well as narrative projects utilizing anamorphic techniques and distinctive visual storytelling.
